name: Auto-Response / Bot
scenarios: Order tracking link sharing (when tracking ID is available)
FAQ — shipping policy, return policy, payment options
Festival greetings / auto-replies to common greetings
Positive comment acknowledgment (thank you, emoji reactions)
After-hours auto-reply with expected response time
authority: Can send pre-approved template replies, share links, acknowledge messages, filter spam. Cannot make promises, process refunds, offer custom discounts, or handle any complaint.

name: Frontline Support Agent
handler_role: Customer Support Executive / Social Media Handler
scenarios: Price questions — single product, bulk pricing structure
Order status check requiring manual lookup
Redirecting to correct channel (website, WhatsApp, email)
Influencer/collaboration inquiry — initial response and info collection
authority: Can apply standard discount codes (up to 10% OFF), initiate standard returns within policy, modify orders before dispatch, share product information, collect collaboration inquiries. Cannot approve refunds above ₹500, offer custom pricing, handle damage complaints requiring compensation, or override policies.

name: Senior Support / Team Lead
handler_role: Senior Customer Support Executive / Support Team Lead
scenarios: Damaged product complaint — requires replacement/refund decision
Wrong product received — requires re-shipment coordination
Customer threatening negative review or social media backlash
Complex return/exchange cases (outside standard policy window)
Payment disputes or failed transaction resolution
Influencer deal negotiation and terms finalization
notification_channels: Direct WhatsApp message to Team Lead
authority: Can approve refunds up to ₹5,000, offer custom discounts up to 20% OFF, authorize free replacements, offer store credit up to ₹1,000 as compensation, negotiate bulk pricing within pre-approved ranges, approve influencer barter deals up to ₹3,000 product value. Cannot authorize refunds above ₹5,000, approve paid influencer deals, change company policies, or handle legal threats.

name: Operations Manager
scenarios: Legal threats or consumer forum complaints
Viral negative social media posts about the brand
Systemic product quality issues (multiple complaints about same product)
Brand collaboration proposals and partnership approvals
Paid influencer campaign approvals and budgeting
Customer data privacy or security concerns
Payment gateway or system-level issues affecting multiple orders
authority: Can approve refunds up to ₹25,000, authorize paid influencer deals up to ₹50,000, approve bulk contracts, issue formal apology statements, create policy exceptions for VIP customers, coordinate with courier partners at management level, approve brand collaboration terms, authorize compensation packages. Cannot make decisions with legal implications, approve budgets above ₹50,000, or change brand strategy.

name: Founder / CEO
scenarios: Consumer forum cases requiring official response
Major brand collaboration or strategic partnership decisions
Major policy changes affecting all customers
Key account / VIP customer personal engagement
Insurance claims for high-value shipment losses
Strategic influencer or celebrity endorsement deals
authority: Full authority — can approve any refund amount, make policy changes, authorize legal responses, approve any budget, sign contracts and agreements, make public statements on behalf of the brand, negotiate strategic partnerships, and make final decisions on all escalated matters.
